howToLead: Declaration defines what the platform may build and under which rules. Everything declared is held in the registries.

howToSteps.text: View the existing declarations under Registry in the navbar.
Author a new declaration from Pack authoring. Action buttons appear only where your authority allows them.
Try one of the scenarios below to see a declaration take effect.

howToLead: Commissioning turns an Objective into a governed SEU, composed from the declarations.

howToSteps.text: Review the existing Objectives, or create a new one.
Open an Objective and compose its Engineering Behavior Model.
Commission the SEU from the Objective, then open it from SEUs.
Or work through a scenario below to commission one for you.

howToLead: Execution moves Deliverables forward while Governance responds to what happens.

howToSteps.text: Open a commissioned SEU from SEUs and review its Deliverables and Work Items.
Complete Work Items and watch Quality Gates and Obligations respond.
Raise a Blocker, Risk or Finding, then convert or release it. Follow the outcome in Attention.
Or work through a scenario below, one step at a time.
